currentWork.title: FINAL.39 long-route highway + timeout + fullscreen visual fit
currentWork.releaseStatus: Implementation is validated on PR #177 and awaits production merge/live verification. FINAL.38 remains the current production release until merge.
fieldEvidence: On iPhone, active route geometry still was not visibly present after entering fullscreen MAP despite DOM-path persistence tests passing.
Longer destinations were less likely to use a practical highway than shorter destinations.
rootCause: Fullscreen regression only counted SVG path elements; it did not prove the route was inside the visible MAP viewport. Viewport resize/rotation could leave route geometry out of frame.

Client aborted a route request after 15s while the bounded server path could spend up to about 9s on primary ORS, then Overpass discovery, then up to 6.5s on via-IC ORS. The client could therefore abort before the server completed.

Long-distance active highway discovery used an 18km motorway-sufficiency cap and an 18km combined entry/exit access prefilter, causing long routes to stop searching too early or reject useful farther IC pairs.
scope: Expose fitActive() from the route client and fit the remaining active route, not travelled geometry.
After fullscreen/software-rotation viewport settling, invalidate Leaflet, redraw, then refit active remaining route unless follow-current-position mode is active.
Browser regression asserts route geometry overlaps the visible MAP rectangle before fullscreen, after fullscreen, and after software rotation.
Route client request budget increases from 15s to 20s.
OSM motorway-junction discovery starts in parallel with the baseline ORS request so it does not add its full latency after ORS.
Overpass wall timeout is reduced to 2.8s and via-IC ORS timeout to 5.5s.
Long-route junction radius can expand to 25km; per-end access can reach 25km and combined prefilter 35km.
Motorway sufficiency target can scale to 55% of the primary route up to 45km rather than stopping at 18km.
FINAL.36 final detour caps remain unchanged: +20% time capped +8min and +30% distance capped +10km.
Exact HGV restrictions, 30 route-call/min warm guard, max two active via routes, and no car/straight-line fallback remain unchanged.

verification.longDistanceHighway: PASS: API test proves search expands beyond old 18km radius/access and does not stop after only 18km motorway usage
verification.fullscreenVisibleRoute: PASS: real browser asserts active route overlaps visible MAP before fullscreen, after fullscreen, and after software rotation
verification.timeoutBudget: PASS: client 20s budget exceeds bounded server critical path; junction discovery runs in parallel and via timeout is 5.5s
